2608.23261.title: A Scalable Cross-Domain Event Extraction System via a Unified Generative Training Framework
2608.23261.paper_summary: Event extraction is fundamental to information extraction. Prior approaches often separate event detection and argument extraction or depend on dataset-specific designs, limiting scalability and cross-domain generalization. We propose a unified generative sequence-to-sequence framework that performs event extraction subtasks jointly and supports both pipeline and end-to-end configurations. We fine-tune pretrained language models on multiple event datasets across diverse domains, enabling a single model to retain domain-specific semantics while generalizing over large and evolving label spaces. We demonstrate these capabilities through a web-based application tailored for researchers and practitioners. The platform supports document upload, schema-aware event extraction, visualization of triggers and arguments, and comparison of different extraction configurations across domains.
2608.23261.paper_summary_zh: 事件提取是信息提取的基礎。以往的方法通常將事件檢測和參數提取分開，或依賴於特定數據集的設計，限制了可擴展性和跨領域的泛化。我們提出了一個統一的生成序列到序列框架，能夠共同執行事件提取的子任務，並支持管道和端到端的配置。我們在多個來自不同領域的事件數據集上微調預訓練的語言模型，使單一模型能夠保留特定領域的語義，同時在大型和不斷演變的標籤空間中進行泛化。我們通過一個針對研究人員和實踐者量身定制的基於網頁的應用程序展示了這些能力。該平台支持文檔上傳、模式感知的事件提取、觸發器和參數的可視化，以及跨領域不同提取配置的比較。
